faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form printed on page 1 of this notice) and send it to Dr. Dhanajay Kumar Singh, Principal Investigator, Deptt of Agronomy, College of Agriculture, GBPUAT Pantnagar, U.S. Nagar, Uttarakhand, by post, to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate in Agricultural Sciences; experience NIL.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Fellowship is in the Unreserved Category.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 19.11.26. No separate interview letter will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.answer: Duration of fellowship 2 years (6 months review basis). Engagement given for six month, which may be extended as per requirement.

faq.answer: Department of Agronomy, College of Agriculture, GBPUAT Pantnagar.
